scope: Only public-corpus network fetching; no Rust parser/converter/SDK/OCR/model/gold changes.
trigger: PR17 Firefox CI job137271076148 failed at corpus download with TLS handshake timeout, before installing/running Firefox. This new change was not used by the already-requested PR17 retry.

implementation.retry_only: Direct TimeoutError or URLError whose reason is a TimeoutError. Close each failed response and restart the whole GET.
implementation.unchanged_failures: All HTTP errors including503, certificate verification errors, byte-size/signature/hash mismatches and corrupt existing caches. No accepted-source or semantic-gold change.
implementation.atomicity: Validate complete final response before creating the part file; atomic replace/cleanup retained.
implementation.offline: No network requests; same90 pinned source entries verified.

mocks_cover: TLS connect timeout then valid response with unchanged URL/User-Agent/45s
Read timeout closes response and bounded read restarts
Permanent timeout ends after second attempt and preserves original exception
Same-size altered PDF following a timeout fails SHA and is never installed
